errors.quote: For $0\le i<f-1$ (top position set aside) ... so no segment carries into the next and $S_0$ agrees with the XOR permutation $T_0.$ ... so this implements $T_0$ everywhere.
errors.problem: The page claims at the start that the procedure XORs at all selected positions, but its shifts sum only over $i\le f-2$ and it never returns to the set-aside top position. The paper's $T_0$ performs the XORs only at $j_0,\dots,j_{f-2}$, and a final two-bit XOR on $x_{j_{f-1}},y_{j_{f-1}}$ (elementary-streams lemma, $O(V)$) supplies the omitted position; for $f=1$ that step is the entire algorithm. As written, the page's procedure misses position $j_{f-1}$ and does nothing when $f=1$.

errors.quote: Since $T_0$ and $S_0$ are bijections agreeing off $\mathcal B,$ $T_0S_0^{-1}$ fixes $\mathcal B^c$ and permutes $\mathcal B,$
errors.problem: Agreement off $\mathcal B$ is not enough by itself. The paper also uses that $T_0$ preserves the guard values, hence $\mathcal B$, so that $S_0(\mathcal B^c)=T_0(\mathcal B^c)=\mathcal B^c$ and $S_0(\mathcal B)=\mathcal B$.
